**Coaching note:**

When you spot an undefended piece being attacked by your queen or rook with check, calculate whether the forced reply walks into mate. Here White's h3 pawn is undefended. After Qxh3+ (check), White *must* block with Nh2—the only legal move. Then Qg2 is checkmate because the king has no escape squares. The lesson: forcing moves (checks especially) often reveal mating patterns the opponent couldn't prevent.
